001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropContainsImpliesEqualCard2 extends Propagator<Variable> {
018
019    private final SetVar subset;
020    private final IntVar subsetCard;
021    private final SetVar superset;
022
023    public PropContainsImpliesEqualCard2(SetVar subset, IntVar subsetCard, SetVar superset) {
024        super(new Variable[]{subsetCard, superset}, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, false);
025        this.subset = subset;
026        this.subsetCard = subsetCard;
027        this.superset = superset;
028    }
029
030    @Override
031    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
032        if (vIdx == 0) {
033            return IntEventType.INSTANTIATE.getMask() + IntEventType.DECUPP.getMask();
034        }
035        assert vIdx == 1;
036        return SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER.getMask();
037    }
038
039    @Override
040    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
041        if (subsetCard.getUB() == superset.getLB().size()) {
042            PropUtil.envSubsetKer(subset, superset, this);
043        }
044        if (subsetCard.getUB() <= superset.getLB().size()) {
045            setPassive();
046        }
047    }
048
049    @Override
050    public ESat isEntailed() {
051        if (subsetCard.getLB() > superset.getUB().size()) {
052            return ESat.FALSE;
053        }
054        if (subsetCard.getUB() <= superset.getLB().size()) {
055            return ESat.TRUE;
056        }
057        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
058    }
059}
